title: Storyboard
description: v2 minimal flat shape: segments[] is the segment array. Phase 04 writes plan fields (id / scene_number / duration_seconds / model / narrative / needs_keyframe / uses_prev_video). Phase 06 patches `prompt` + `references`; the agent organizes shot structure and transitions inside the prompt string, with no shots[] array. Phase 07 patches `video_url`, `video_state`, and optional fallback_history. The schema only enforces Phase 04 required fields.

id.description: Unique segment id, e.g. 'seg_01_a1f9'. Once written in Phase 04, it remains stable across phases.

scene_number.description: Written in Phase 04. Belongs to the upstream screenplay scene index.

duration_seconds.description: Written in Phase 04. Segment duration in seconds. Phase 07 fallback may change it when switching models.

model.description: Written in Phase 04. Video model; Phase 07 fallback may change it.

narrative.description: Written in Phase 04. One target-language sentence summarizing this segment, using [[id]] to mention characters where useful. Used for the agent's self-check and Phase 06 prompt drafting.

needs_keyframe.description: Marked in Phase 04 and read by Phase 05 / 06. true means Phase 05 uses image-generation to synthesize a refined first frame.

uses_prev_video.description: Marked in Phase 04 and read by Phase 07. true means Phase 07 uses the previous segment video as ref_video_url. The first segment must be false.

prompt.description: Patched in Phase 06. Complete prompt passed directly to video-generation. The agent organizes shot structure in text (one shot every 1-3 seconds, with type/camera/transition in prose). Contains [[id]] placeholders. Keyframe segments start with `@image1 as the opening frame.`

references.description: Patched in Phase 06. Each segment has exactly one location. For needs_keyframe=true segments, references[0] must be the keyframe with alias=image1. Each reference uses either `ref_id` lookup into reference_list or a previous storyboard segment (default), or inline `image_url` / `asset_id` / `video_url`. Both modes still include alias + as.

ref_id.description: Lookup mode: points to reference_list.entries[].id. video_continuation is the exception and may point to the previous storyboard.segments[].id. Inline mode may omit this.

image_url.description: Inline mode: directly provides a publicly accessible image URL without adding it to reference_list. Omit in lookup mode; the tool layer reads it from reference_list.

asset_id.description: Inline mode: directly provides an existing id returned by register-asset, useful for external production reuse. Omit in lookup mode; the tool layer reads it from reference_list.

video_url.description: Inline mode for video_continuation only: directly provides a video URL, bypassing previous-storyboard lookup. Usually paired with `as: video_continuation`.

alias.description: Placeholder replacement target, e.g. 'image1' / 'asset1' / 'video1'. The tool layer replaces [[id]] in the prompt according to alias, producing the segment model's native placeholder syntax (e.g. Seedance `@imageN` / `@assetN` / `@videoN`); it adapts per `segment.model`, so choose aliases that match the reference channels that model actually accepts (see `dl generate-video model <model>`).

video_url.description: Patched in Phase 07. URL returned by video-generation.
